name: Drupal Association Extras
description: Drupal Association add-on that, at alpha, adds one 'Ready to launch?' link to core's admin Navigation toolbar via a hook_install config action.
project_description:
Drupal Association Extras is a module used as a container for additional features to be incorporated into Drupal to support Drupal Association initiatives and programs. Each of these features should be independently enable-able/disable-able with configuration 

 Features 
 During it's initial development phase, the first feature being included is: 

 
 Promotion of Drupal hosting partners in the Admin UI, to be included and enabled in the Drupal CMS trial experience 
 
 Future development 
 We may include additional features over time, some targeted at trial users, some at live websites. These might include things such as: 

 
 DrupalCon Promotion 
 Drupal Upstream Support subscriptions (for end-users to support Drupal infrastructure) 
 and more 
 
 Post-Installation 
 Once installed, the new Drupal Association provided functionality is presented in the admin toolbar.
